contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete, Roman, copper alloy, nummi of the House of Constantine 330-335 Obverse: Laureate head right. Inscription: CONSTAN[]( CA(ES). Reverse: Two soldiers holding two standards. Inscription: GLOR[IA EXERCITVS]. Die axis: 12 o'clock. The coin is in good condition, only slightly worn with fragments missing from the top
